This is the upstream source at the time of the Boring Notch vendor update.
Its Perl bridge matches the existing bundled bridge byte-for-byte.
The MVP packaging script rebuilds this source with Xcode's clang, so the
release's embedded adapter has explicitly identified corresponding source.
